intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both teach {{course}} in {{cityA}}, but they are not the same kind of campus. This page compares their recorded fees, placements, admission routes and NIRF standing, using our database and official pages we opened in {{year}}.

AIIE Ahmedabad vs Nirma University comes down to scale and recognition. Nirma is a full university with a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 101. AIIE is a smaller infrastructure-focused institute, now part of Adani University's engineering faculty at Shantigram.

sections.heading: AIIE Ahmedabad vs Nirma University for B.Tech: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose Nirma University if you want a wider set of B.Tech branches, a GUJCET plus JEE Main route, and a place that already appears in the NIRF 2025 Engineering list at rank 101.

Choose AIIE Ahmedabad if you want a smaller, infrastructure- and ICT-focused campus on the SG Highway and are comfortable with a newer university brand that does not yet have an NIRF Engineering rank in our records.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: Our records now follow the official 2026-27 notices. AIIE's page lists FRC tuition of ₹1,90,995 a year and a four-year total of ₹8,05,980, including a first-year total of ₹2,02,995 with enrolment and exam charges.

Nirma's official B.Tech admissions page lists a fee of ₹2,75,000 per year for the All India and ACPC seats in 2026-27. With other fees and a refundable deposit, the first-year total comes to ₹2,94,700.

Nirma's annual academic fee is higher than AIIE's. Confirm the current FRC and university circulars before you budget, because AIIE marks tuition as under revision and Nirma also lists NRI fees separately in US dollars.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, AIIE's 2023 figures for the Information and Communication Technology programme are an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹12 lakh. These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.

Nirma's recorded 2023 figures for B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering are an average of ₹7 lakh and a highest of ₹88 lakh. The 2016 row on the same programme is older and should not be mixed with the 2023 numbers.
The years match, but the branches may not. Use each institute's latest official placement report and compare the same graduating class and programme.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Nirma admits B.Tech students through the Gujarat ACPC state quota, which uses GUJCET, and through an All India JEE Main category. Eligibility follows ACPC's Class 12 Physics and Mathematics rule, as set out on Nirma's admissions page.

AIIE, through Adani University, also follows ACPC for a large share of seats and uses JEE Main for all-India and NRI-sponsored seats. Its official programme page additionally mentions a small CUET-UG share.
Cut-offs change every year. Read the current ACPC and institute admission notices rather than last year's closing ranks.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both campuses are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. AIIE sits at Shantigram Township, near Vaishnodevi Circle on the SG Highway. Nirma's Institute of Technology is on the Sarkhej-Gandhinagar highway.
If you already plan to stay in Ahmedabad, the choice is about the university, the branch list and the official fee, not a change of city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a broader B.Tech menu, a published NIRF 2025 Engineering rank and the higher recorded 2023 CSE average on this page, Nirma University is the stronger fit.

If you want a smaller ICT or infrastructure-focused campus and a lower official annual tuition than Nirma's ₹2.75 lakh fee, AIIE Ahmedabad is the more direct option, with the caveat that it has no NIRF Engineering rank here.
Do not use the lowest raw row in the detailed table. Check the official 2026-27 fee notice for the quota and branch you will actually join.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, AIIE Ahmedabad or Nirma University, for B.Tech?
faqs.answer: It depends on what you want. Nirma University has a 2025 NIRF Engineering rank of 101, more B.Tech branches and a higher recorded 2023 CSE average. AIIE is smaller, infrastructure- and ICT-focused, and has a lower official annual tuition, but no NIRF Engineering rank in our records.

faqs.question: What are the official B.Tech fees for AIIE Ahmedabad vs Nirma University?
faqs.answer: AIIE's official 2026-27 page lists FRC tuition of ₹1,90,995 a year and a four-year total of ₹8,05,980. Nirma's official page lists ₹2,75,000 per year for 2026-27, or ₹2,94,700 in the first year with other fees and a refundable deposit. Confirm both notices before you pay.

faqs.question: Do AIIE and Nirma both accept JEE Main and GUJCET?
faqs.answer: Nirma uses GUJCET through the Gujarat ACPC quota and JEE Main for All India seats. AIIE also follows ACPC for a large share of seats and JEE Main for all-India and NRI-sponsored seats. Check the current seat matrix on each official admissions page.

faqs.question: How do placements compare for AIIE Ahmedabad and Nirma University?
faqs.answer: Our 2023 records show an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh for AIIE's ICT programme, and an average of ₹7 lakh and a highest of ₹88 lakh for Nirma CSE. These are historical figures from one year and one branch, not a guarantee for the next batch.

faqs.question: Are AIIE Ahmedabad and Nirma University in the same city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both are in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. AIIE is at Shantigram on the SG Highway. Nirma's Institute of Technology is on the Sarkhej-Gandhinagar highway.

faqs.question: Should I treat this comparison as a final admission decision?
faqs.answer: No. Fees, eligibility and placements change by year, quota and branch. Verify the current official fee notice, ACPC brochure and placement report of each institute before you apply.
